ammonia.reason: Low NH3 from amino-acid deamination; no surface flora deacidification and low moisture limits urease activity.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism by raw-milk wild microbiota from pasture milk.

bitter.reason: Residual hydrophobic alpha-s1-casein peptides, mostly hydrolyzed to amino acids by NSLAB peptidases over 2-3 yr.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone essentially absent.

browning.reason: Concentrated free amino acids and carbonyls from long proteolysis drive Maillard browning when grated and heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl from citrate by Lactococcus reduced to acetoin and 2,3-butanediol during extended aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic 92 mg/kg and hexanoic 30 mg/kg from lipoprotein lipase and NSLAB esterase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Very low 26.6% moisture and rigid Ca-phosphate para-casein prevents fat coalescence and mouth-coating.

crumbliness.reason: Long proteolysis plus tyrosine and calcium-lactate crystals create fracture planes in low-moisture matrix.

firmness.reason: High cook, pressing and 24-mo drying to 26.6% moisture with Ca-phosphate crosslinked para-casein.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker degradation by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by NSLAB esterases.

goaty.reason: No goat milk branched-chain acids; 3-methylbutanoic acid <1 mg/kg from Leu catabolism only.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile via NSLAB aminotransferases plus pyrazines in long aging.

melt.reason: Low moisture and 5.6% salt-in-moisture with demineralized aged casein restricts flow to softening with oiling.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Very low 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation; no mold lipoxygenase activity.

oil_off.reason: 34.3% fat, 46.7% FDM pools as free oil when contracted protein matrix cannot emulsify on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step; no guaiacol/syringol deposition from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 594 mg/kg from heterofermentative NSLAB and lactose fermentation; propionic <74 mg/kg.

stretch.reason: Rennet-cooked aged matrix lacks intact plasticizable casein for pasta-filata stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Residual H2S/methional from Met demethiolation; high-cook sulfhydryls largely dissipated over aging.

sweet.reason: Zero lactose; sweet perception from glycerol, proline, alanine and low propionate balancing salt.

umami.reason: Very high free glutamate from chymosin/plasmin plus Lactobacillus peptidase proteolysis over 2-3 yr.
